caseName: Charleston & South Side Bridge Co. v. Virginia
caseNameFull: Charleston & South Side Bridge Company v. State of West Virginia
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of Appeals of the State of West Virginia.
attorneys: Mr. W. S. Laidley for motion to dismiss., Mr. Malcolm Jackson opposing.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Morrison v. Watson, 154 U. S. 111; Miller v. Cornwall Railroad Company, 168 U. S. 131, and cases cited.
